payload.title: New accounts are seeded from the organisation
payload.description:
Design only for now (see HUM-be87f4 comments): a service-managed StackSet on an OU delivers the baseline; accounts are created as code in a small org repo; read-only everyday SSO with a break-glass admin. Built last, after Ryan decides.

```gherkin
Feature: New accounts arrive seeded

  Scenario: A new account in the Papyrus deployments OU gets the baseline
    Given an account created in the Papyrus deployments OU
    When it joins the OU
    Then the organisation delivers the baseline stack automatically
    And the account's pipeline can deploy without a person touching it
```
